# Upstream provenance

Source: npm vite-plugin-vue-layouts-next 3.3.1, https://github.com/loicduong/vite-plugin-vue-layouts-next . MIT license retained. Published runtime files copied unchanged except dist/index.mjs imports the named expand export from patched brace-expansion 5.0.12. package.json selects that version and omits upstream development scripts/dependencies. This local compatibility patch is temporary until an upstream release supports patched brace-expansion.
